# FileType <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FileType:Int32 file:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | In | String | required | The path to look at. |

**Returns:** 0 when nothing is there, 1 for a file, 2 for a folder.

## Description

Tells what is at a path, so you can check for something before you open it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print FileType("files_type_nothing_here")
CreateDir "files_type_folder"
Print FileType("files_type_folder")
DeleteDir "files_type_folder"
```

```text
0
2
```
